To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
perceived image, perceived SQ, perceived value and passengers’ satisfaction are the key determinants of passengers’ future BI in the domestic aviation market.
airline SQ is the most important antecedent of passenger’s future BI in domestic airline market in Indian context.

the dimensions of convenience, reliability and promptness of airline SQ have direct influence on passengers perceived image, perceived image and passengers perceived value have direct influence on passenger satisfaction and finally passenger satisfaction has a direct influence on passenger’s future behavioral intentions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a conceptual framework to examine the interrelationship among airline SQ, perceived value, perceived image and passenger satisfaction in influencing passenger’s future BI in the airline sector in Indian context.
the interrelationships among SQ, perceived image and perceived value, passenger’s satisfaction and their effect on passengers’ future behavior in Indian domestic aviation market.
the identification of factors that influence passengers’ future BI in Indian domestic aviation market.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this research has made a contribution to the airline SQ literature and has also provided some useful insights for the airline managers in Indian context.
the study has empirically tested the relationship among the constructs of SQ, perceived image and perceived value, passenger’s satisfaction and future BI in Indian domestic aviation sector.
the airline service quality, perceived image, passenger satisfaction and perceived value are important antecedents to passengers’ future behavioral intention in the Indian airline market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the airline service quality dimensions of convenience and promptness are important in influencing passengers’ future behavioral intention.
the findings of this study will provide a better understanding of the factors that influence the passengers’ BI.
the airline industry in India has a lot of potential for growth, but the airlines need to understand the passenger’s needs, expectations and preferences and provide the same.
The main takeaway from our work is that
airline SQ has a significant impact on perceived image and perceived value.
airline SQ, perceived value, perceived image and passenger satisfaction are the key factors in influencing passenger’s BI.
airline SQ is a multidimensional construct and the dimensions are convenience, promptness and reliability.
